description:
LinkPower Companion helps you monitor and control compatible Link-Power batteries from your iPhone. Connect nearby over Bluetooth, or use optional PeakDo cloud access for remote monitoring on supported devices.

GLANCEABLE LIVE STATUS
- Home Screen widgets in small, medium, and large sizes show battery level, power draw, and estimated runtime
- Lock Screen widgets put your battery one swipe away
- Live Activities follow charging and discharging in the Dynamic Island and on the Lock Screen
- Readings refresh when a connection is available; iOS controls background updates

PERFECT FOR STARLINK MINI
Take your Starlink Mini off-grid with confidence. Use the LinkPower app to:
- Track remaining runtime so you know how much streaming, calls, or work time is left
- Watch live power draw to confirm your dish is pulling its expected wattage
- Schedule DC on/off windows to conserve battery overnight or on a duty cycle
- Glance at your Lock Screen Live Activity for live status without unlocking

OPTIONAL CLOUD ACCESS
Sign in to your PeakDo account to link supported batteries and monitor them remotely. Cloud features require an account, a compatible battery, and an internet connection. Nearby Bluetooth monitoring does not require a PeakDo account.

REAL-TIME MONITORING
View live battery level, voltage, current, power draw, and estimated remaining time. Watch readings update automatically as your device charges or discharges.

DC PORT CONTROL
Turn the DC output on or off directly from your phone. Monitor DC voltage, current, and power. Toggle DC bypass mode on supported devices.

USB-C PORT STATUS
Track USB-C charging and discharging activity, power readings, and port temperature. Control USB-C output on compatible hardware.

SCHEDULED TIMERS
Create automated DC on/off schedules. Available schedule types and capacity depend on your battery model and firmware.

POWER LIMIT CONFIGURATION
Adjust supported USB-C power limits. Available controls and power ranges depend on your battery model and firmware.

ADDITIONAL FEATURES
- Custom device names and battery-level alerts
- Optional Starlink connection statistics on your local network
- In-app support requests with diagnostics
- Account deletion requests from Settings
- Sync your phone's clock to the device
- View firmware version and hardware details
- Expert mode with advanced device controls
- Demo mode to explore the app without hardware

SUPPORTED DEVICES
- Link-Power 1 (LP1)
- Link-Power 2 (LP2)
- Link-Power+ (LP+)
- Link-Power 3 (LP3)
- Link-Power Ultra
- Link-Power Pod

Requires iOS 17 or later and a compatible PeakDo Link-Power device. Use Demo Mode to explore the LinkPower app without hardware.

The LinkPower app is an unofficial, community-built companion. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by PeakDo Tech, the manufacturer of the Link-Power hardware, Starlink, or SpaceX. Link-Power, PeakDo, and Starlink are trademarks of their respective owners.

Questions or feedback? Visit https://linkpower.app or email support@linkpower.app — we read every message.

whatsNew:
Link-Power Ultra and Link-Power Pod now work with the app, so you can monitor and control PeakDo's newest batteries from your iPhone.

New
• Support for Link-Power Ultra and Link-Power Pod, including Wi-Fi setup and PeakDo account linking.

Improved
• Widgets and Live Activities now show when a reading is out of date instead of an old battery level.
• A tidier Live Activity that fits long device names.
• Unlock and purchase status now appear directly in Settings.
• Support requests include Bluetooth setup details, so we can track down connection problems faster.

Fixed
• Switching PeakDo accounts could briefly show the previous account's details.
• Fewer unnecessary screen refreshes while cloud features are in use.
